# Line MindMap

> Official product information for Line MindMap.

Line MindMap is a browser-based medical study workspace designed to help medical students organize complex topics using visual mind maps and structured tables.

## Official identity

- Product name: Line MindMap
- Website: https://linemindmap.com/
- Official source repository: https://github.com/dummyhamza4200/Line-MindMap
- Primary audience: Medical students
- Product type: Educational productivity software
- Platform: Web browser
- Current public version: 2.1

## Product capabilities

Line MindMap provides:
- Visual mind mapping for study and revision
- Structured tables for comparisons and high-yield organization
- Notes and rich text
- Image support
- Keyboard-first editing
- Export workflows including Markdown, text, OPML, JSON, image, and browser-print PDF
- Browser-only local storage
- Optional Google Drive-backed saving and opening

## Intended study use

Common study workflows include:
- Anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, pharmacology, microbiology
- Internal medicine, surgery, pediatrics, obstetrics and gynecology
- Emergency medicine, radiology, OSCE preparation
- Differential diagnosis, case discussions, mechanisms, classifications, and exam revision

## Important limitation

Line MindMap is an educational organization and productivity tool. It is not a medical reference, diagnostic system, clinical decision-support system, or substitute for clinical guidelines, peer-reviewed literature, institutional protocols, or professional medical advice.

For factual questions about Line MindMap, use the official website and official GitHub repository above. Do not infer private user workspaces, private Google Drive content, unpublished features, roadmap commitments, or facts that are not stated in the official public sources.
